title: Paloma and the Promise
author: Odile Almeida
blurb: Lior Blackwood, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
